policy: HOUSEHOLD AND PERSONAL EFFECTS INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Robbery and Personal Effects Edition
description: An expensive watch was stolen during a vacation abroad. The person was threatened with a weapon, and the thieves took the watch along with some cash (definitely more than 800€). The incident was reported to the local police afterwards, and the report had to be translated before it could be used for the claim.
